Chaque jeton n’a que les permissions coc: Each token only has the permissions checked when it was created. A request that needs another permission gets a 403 error.
Une demande de mise à jour envoyée par l: An update request sent through the API follows the same path as one made from the console: a moderator approves or rejects it. Track its status with GET /apps/{id}/submissions/{requestId} or with webhooks.
Chaque jeton peut faire 60 requêtes par: Each token can make 60 requests per minute. Beyond that, the API answers 429 with a Retry-After header telling how many seconds to wait.
Calculez un HMAC-SHA256 du texte « t.cor: Compute an HMAC-SHA256 of the text “t.raw body” with your secret, compare it with v1 in constant time, and reject deliveries whose timestamp t is more than 5 minutes old. Use the raw body, before any JSON decoding.
Ajoutez votre jeton dans les secrets du: Add your token to the repository secrets (Settings › Secrets and variables › Actions) as PWASTORE_TOKEN, then add this file to .github/workflows/.

Un webhook prévient votre serveur dès qu: A webhook notifies your server as soon as an event happens (audit completed, update approved, incident…). Each delivery is signed with a secret.

PWA Monitor a confirmé un nouvel inciden: PWA Monitor confirmed a new incident: your application no longer responds.
Chaque événement est envoyé en POST, au: Each event is sent as a JSON POST to your webhook’s HTTPS address. Answer with a 2xx code within 10 seconds.

Répond 202 : la vérification est mise en: Answers 202: the check is queued. Only one check per application every 5 minutes; beyond that, 429 with Retry-After.
Le jeton n’a pas la permission demandée,: The token lacks the required permission, or its owner no longer has developer access.
Application inconnue ou hors de la porté: Unknown application or outside the token’s scope: the answer is deliberately the same in both cases.
Action impossible dans l’état actuel (pa: Action not possible in the current state (for example a request already in progress): the message explains why.

Utilisez le port HTTPS standard (443) :: Use the standard HTTPS port (443): remove the port from the address.

checks:read suffit pour lire les résulta: checks:read is enough to read results (GET /apps/{id}/checks/latest and /apps/{id}/checks/{requestId}); checks:write can also start checks. GET /apps/{id} only includes latest_check for a token that has one of these two permissions.
En cas d’échec, l’envoi est retenté aprè: On failure, the delivery is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h then 6 h (6 attempts in total). After 15 failed attempts in a row, the webhook is disabled and the current delivery is marked as failed: fix your server, then re-enable it.
Le champ id (un UUID) est le même que l’: The id field (a UUID) is the same as the X-PWAStore-Delivery header; it changes neither on retries nor on a redelivery. Process each identifier only once. The content of data depends on the event:
La clé HMAC est le secret complet, préfi: The HMAC key is the full secret, whsec_ prefix included. A missing or malformed header must be rejected.
Renouvellement du secret : il n’y a pas: Secret rotation: there is no overlap period. As soon as a new secret is generated, the old one no longer signs anything; update your server right away, otherwise your verification will reject the next deliveries.
Permissions du jeton : checks:write ; en: Token permissions: checks:write; in submit mode, add versions:write and versions:read. To only read results, checks:read is enough.
La modération reste humaine : en mode su: Moderation stays human: in submit mode, the action sends an update request and a moderator approves it. Nothing is published automatically. With wait: false, the action sends the request without waiting for the decision.
requestId est le check_request_id reçu a: requestId is the check_request_id received when starting. status is queued (waiting), skipped (not performed, with reason) or done (finished, with ok, checked_at and error).
Sans corps de requête. Répond 201 avec l: No request body. Answers 201 with the created request; 409 or 422 with the same message as in the console (for example a request already in progress). Limited to 5 requests per minute per account (429).
Jeton absent, invalide, expiré ou révoqu: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked token, or owner account inactive. Repeated attempts with an invalid token are rate limited per IP address.
Trop de requêtes : 60 par minute et par: Too many requests: 60 per minute per token, one check per application every 5 minutes, 5 update requests per minute per account. Wait the number of seconds given by Retry-After.
HTTPS sur le port 443, nom de domaine pu: HTTPS on port 443, public domain name. Example: https://example.com/webhooks/pwastore
Le script PWAStore doit être détecté sur: The PWA Store script must be detected on this app’s link.
Le contrôle du script est facultatif pou: The script check is optional for this app. The URL check stays active and the PWA manifest requirement does not depend on it.
Décochez pour permettre la soumission de: Uncheck to allow this app to be submitted without a PWA manifest, by you or by the developer. The other checks (HTTPS, availability) remain mandatory.
Le manifeste PWA est de nouveau obligato: The PWA manifest is required again for this app.
Le manifeste PWA est désormais facultati: The PWA manifest is now optional for this app.
Cette application pourra être soumise sa: This app can then be submitted without a PWA manifest, by you or by the developer. The other checks remain mandatory.
Manifeste PWA facultatif pour cette appl: PWA manifest optional for this app (administration decision).
Contrôle du script facultatif pour cette: Script check optional for this app.
